lead.jd_excerpt: Manage and provide direct technical and application support for process analytics business in Singapore. Coordinate with sales team, sub vendors for the integration of process analyzer. Perform troubleshooting and conduct site visit for process analyzer. Setup onsite trial and conduct review with customer. Prepare and deliver in-house and onsite technical/product training to customers. Create technical materials to support the sales team. JOB REQUIREMENTS: Min Bachelor's Degree/Post Graduate Diploma/Professional Degree in Engineering (Chemical), Engineering (Environmental), Engineering (Environmental, Water Treatment) or equivalent. No experience needed, training provided Those with relevant experience will be an advantage $3700 to $3800 (For candidates with no experience) Up to $4.5K (For candidates with experience) Scientific Analytical MNC Interested candidates, please forward your resume to kevynhuang@recruitexpress.com.sg Consultant: Huang Jingsheng Kevyn (R1333338) Recruit Express Pte Ltd (99C4599)
